title: Vampire Hunter D Returns With 2026 US Release
content:
When it comes to slaying vampires, there is one anime character who has been front and center in terms of laying creatures of the night to rest. Even though it’s been decades since we last witnessed D staking some vamps, thanks to Vampire Hunter D: Bloodlust , the swordsman still finds his way back into the public eye. Recently, Dark Horse Comics announced that not only is it bringing D back, but it will be adapting classic stories involving the son of Dracula for North America. While a new anime adaptation has yet to be revealed, these projects might lead us to seeing D back on the screen.

Dark Horse shared that a new comic book series was set to adapt a classic D story in Vampire Hunter D: Fortress of Blood . While not based on any of the previous stories from the novel series or anime films, this four-issue storyline is spawned from a concept from Vampire Hunter D’s creator Hideyuki Kikuchi. Written by author Chris Condon and drawn by artist Filipe Andrade, the series is planning to release its first issue in December of this year. In the story, D struggles with a new vampire lord who is dead set on eradicating humanity and must now attempt to lay siege to an impenetrable fortress. This comic series isn’t the only D-centric series that Dark Horse is releasing.

Vampire Hunter D’s Big Comeback

Alongside this upcoming four-issue series , Dark Horse is also planning to translate Vampire Hunter D: The Rose Princess into English for a North American release. Landing in June 2027, the manga revolves around a female vampire princess who terrorizes a village and claims victims at her discretion. With one villager attempting to save his beloved from a fanged fate, he enlists the aid of D to go on a quest to defeat the evil. The original story was published as a novel in the 1990s, arriving as the ninth major story of the Vampire Hunter D franchise.

On top of the big announcements regarding the return of D , series creator Hideyuki Kikuchi shared his approval for the project and stated, “I am deeply honored to finally see the adaptation of D into an American comic book. I never could have imagined that D, a series born in Japan, would be reborn in the form of an American Comic. I would like to express my gratitude to Dark Horse Comics for making this a reality, and above all, to the people that help make it happen, Michael Gombos , the editor, Judy Khuu, as well as to Filipe Andrade, who created the wonderful illustrations, and Chris Condon, who crafted a superb script tailored for the American comic book format from my original scenario! I hope that this comic will serve as a catalyst for the story of D to spread beyond Japan and the United States, and reach the entire world.”

title: New The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 Trailer Confirms Crunchyroll Release Date – Watch
content:
The Apothecary Diaries is making a massive return later this Fall with more of the anime than ever, and a new trailer from Crunchyroll is showing off Season 3 ahead of its October release date. The anime adaptation for Hyūganatsu’s The Apothecary Diaries has been an absolute runaway success since it made its debut, and has quickly returned for even more episodes. But it’s getting ready for its biggest season yet with a third batch of episodes coming later this Fall, and a new feature film coming to theaters too .

The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 is making its return to Crunchyroll later this October as part of their jam packed Fall 2026 slate of exclusives , and it’s going to be offering the first cour of its episodes before it returns in 2027. This third season is kicking off a disastrous new arc for Maomao and the others as a major locust problem is ushering in a famine that could lead to the destruction of everything. Check it all out in action below.

When Does The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 Come Out?

The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 will be making its debut on October 2nd , and it will be exclusively streaming with Crunchyroll as part of their Fall 2026 schedule. The anime will then be taking a break in the Winter months next year before then returning for its second cour of episodes sometime in April 2027 as part of the Spring 2027 schedule. This new trailer also reveals some big updates about the new additions to the cast along with the first tease of the new season’s opening theme, “Kumo o Nukekazashimo e Watashidake” as performed by yorushika.

New additions to the cast for The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 include Reina Ueda as Bai Niangniang, who is teased to play a big role in the coming arc. But while this seems to be a mystery that Maomao may not be able to solve, it’s something that is going to be much bigger than anything that she has ever faced before. But like the other seasons before it, fans are likely going to love following Maomao as she digs further into this newest mystery.

What’s Next for The Apothecary Diaries?

This isn’t going to be all for the franchise, however, as The Apothecary Diaries also has a new feature film coming to theaters later this year as well. The Apothecary Diaries has a new original movie project hitting Japan later this December , and it features a brand new story from the creator themselves. It’s yet to be revealed how it’s going to tie into the rest of the anime’s canon, if at all, but it’s going to be yet another big mystery that Maomao is going to need to get to the bottom of.

But unfortunately while The Apothecary Diaries has set a release date in Japan for its new movie outing, it has yet to confirm any potential international release plans as of the time of this writing . It’s highly likely it’s going to hit other shores considering how massive of a franchise this really is, but international fans might have to wait until 2027 for their chance to see the new movie for themselves. For now, make sure you catch up with all of the TV seasons available with Crunchyroll in the meantime.

title: One Piece Drops New Look Trailer for Netflix LEGO Special – Watch Now
content:
One Piece is coming back to Netflix later this Fall with an official LEGO makeover, and now fans have gotten a new look at what to expect with a new trailer showing it all off. One Piece has been a massive hit with Netflix ever since it debuted its official live-action series adaptation , and that success has resulted in two seasons so far. With a third season of the live-action series in the works, there’s even more from the franchise on the way as Netflix has even more projects coming down the pipeline.

LEGO ONE PIECE is a new special coming to Netflix this September , and it’s going to be offering a fun new reimagining of the live-action series’ events told through a fun LEGO style. Seeing Usopp recounting the adventures of the Straw Hat pirates over the course of the first two seasons to a Chopper that has no idea how much Usopp is lying about it all, it’s definitely going to be a great way to get hyped for that coming season. You can check it out in action below.

When Does LEGO One Piece Special Come Out on Netflix?

LEGO One Piece is teased to be a two part special making its debut with Netflix on September 29th , and it will be retelling the events of the first two seasons through Usopp’s own unique vision. The trailer also finds a way to tie it back into the canon of the live-action series through this too as it does make a lot of sense that Usopp would be catching Tony Tony Chopper up on everything that happened before he joined the crew. And this gives the opportunity for the live-action crew to lean more into the comedy of it al.

The live-action One Piece cast will be reprising their roles for the new LEGO specia too with Iñaki Godoy as Monkey D. Luffy, Mackenyu as Roronoa Zoro, Emily Rudd as Nami, Jacob Romero as Usopp, Taz Skylar as Sanji, Charithra Chandran as Miss Wednesday, and Mikaela Hoover as Tony Tony Chopper all confirmed. And after fans get more One Piece through this LEGO special later this Fall, there is going to be much more of the franchise coming to Netflix in 2027 with both anime and live-action releases planned.

What’s New for One Piece on Netflix in 2027?

One Piece has been such a hit with Netflix that the streaming service has been in the works on multiple releases for the franchise. This LEGO special is only one cool new release as One Piece: The Battle of Alabasta ( the official name of the live-action series’ third season ) is currently scheduled to come to the platform sometime in 2027. A release date has yet to be confirmed as of this time, but it’s going to feature lots of new faces in Luffy’s biggest battle yet.

That’s not all that’s on the way either as One Piece also has an exclusive anime now in the works too. The One Piece is a brand new remake anime series scheduled to release with Netflix in February 2027 , and will be adapting Eiichiro Oda’s original manga from the very beginning. Brought to life by WIT Studio, it’s going to kick off a huge new year for the franchise on Netflix.

title: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War Reveals Ichigo's New Blood Chain Bankai Form in Visual and Video
content:
BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War (TYBW) Part 4 revealed a new visual and video to show Ichigo’s new “blood chain” form. The anime returned with the fourth and final cour, subtitled The Calamity , on July 25. It is set to run for 10 episodes. In last week’s episode, Zaraki and Toshiro revealed their Bankai abilities, with Yuki Kaji joining the voice cast as the older version of Toshiro.

You can watch the clip from the latest episode below.

ALSO READ: BLEACH JET Artbook and Ryogo Narita’s School Life Novel Return, Fan Vote and 2027 Exhibition Announced

A special visual for BLEACH THE STORIES was also revealed, also featuring Ichigo’s new form.

Created by Tite Kubo, BLEACH was serialized in Weekly Shonen Jump from 2001 to 2016 and concluded with 74 volumes. The manga has exceeded 130 million copies in circulation worldwide, making it one of the best-selling manga series of all time.

The original anime adaptation aired from 2004 to 2012 and received four theatrical films. The franchise returned in 2022 with BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War , adapting the manga’s final arc. Its final part (Part 4) is set to release in July. Tite Kubo has confirmed it will include even more original material than the previous parts , expanding the manga’s final battles.

On a related note, BLEACH: Mirrors High revealed its protagonists in a new trailer, with the game featuring original character designs by Tite Kubo.

title: 12 Years Ago, Netflix’s Most Depressing Animated Series Debuted
content:
Netflix has created its fair share of original programming to help prove it’s become a premier spot for streaming, with the animation world being no exception. While the streaming service has created heart-pounding action series like Devil May Cry and Castlevania , it also created plenty of comedies, including Big Mouth and Inside Job . Amongst the many animated series Netflix has created in its history, only one can be universally thought of as the most “depressing” entry in the platform’s library. Twelve years ago, fans were introduced to a former television star whose journey could sometimes be tough to watch.

In 2014, Bojack Horseman debuted on Netflix, following the titular character as he struggled with his life now that his fame had faded. While Bojack never needed to worry much about money, thanks to being the star of a 90’s sitcom titled “Horsin’ Around,” he had plenty of other things to worry about. Bojack himself was never the best of people, constantly finding himself running afoul of his friends while never quite finding the acceptance he was looking for. Throughout the six seasons of the show, Bojack messes up quite a bit, losing friends and making enemies, but eventually finds the happiest ending that someone like himself could find. So why did Bojack Horseman end after seventy-six episodes?

Bojack Horseman’s Legacy

Despite having quite the lengthy run on Netflix, Bojack’s story would end in 2020, and it wasn’t the creators’ decision. Series creator Raphael Bob-Waksberg has gone on record that the streaming service ultimately decided to end Bojack Horseman with season six, despite the fact that the animator had ideas for “several more years” of the animated series. Even though Bojack’s depressing story would end prematurely, Bob-Waksberg was still happy with the run it ultimately had, noting in previous interviews that many Netflix shows would never have the chance to run for six seasons.

As for the appeal of Bojack Horseman , the anthropomorphic universe saw Bojack messing up his life time and time again, routinely costing him friends and family as a result. While Horseman wouldn’t try to be malicious over the course of six seasons, many found themselves caught up in his addictive personality. Even though the animated series ended prematurely, it did end in a place that felt organic for the titular character.

While Bojack isn’t likely to return, this hasn’t stopped the animated show’s creator from exploring new territory. In 2025, Bob-Waksberg created a new series titled Long Story Short , which followed a human family as viewers explored their past, present, and future. This animated series was confirmed for a second season following its premiere season; Netflix has yet to confirm when the tear-jerker will make its grand return.

title: Luna Goami Performs at Anime India Mumbai 2026 Concert; Animation & More Summit Hosts Kadokawa, 'Sony YAY!' Panels
content:
The convention will host the following screenings:

• Black Torch episode one

• Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation III episode one

• Sparks of Tomorrow episode one

TOHO animation will also have a presence at the event.

The next Anime India event will take place from August 28 through August 30 at NESCO Goregaon.

Naruto director Hayato Date ( Naruto Shippūden , Flame of Recca ) will attend the upcoming Mumbai event as a guest. Voice actor Akari Yura ( The Beginning After The End , Catch Me at the Ballpark! ) will perform as a musical act at the convention's concert. ASCA ( Sword Art Online: Alicization , Edens Zero ) will also perform at the event. Producer Ryōta Hasegawa ( Dr. Stone , Sakamoto Days ) will also attend the event as a guest. The event will host meet and greets for all four musical artists as well as with Ryōta Hasegawa .

Anime India hosted voice actor Kazuhiko Inoue ( Naruto , Parasyte -the maxim- , 2025 Ranma ½ ) as a guest at its event in Delhi. Delhi Anime India took place at Yashobhoomi Convention Centre on June 6 and June 7. YURiKA ( Little Witch Academia , Miss Kuroitsu From the Monster Development Department ) performed at the event as well.

Anime India hosted its Kolkata event at Biswa Bangla Mela Prangan on February 14 and February 15. The event featured a panel and a workshop by director Susumu Mitsunaka ( Haikyu!! director, Weathering With You key animator).

Anime India's previous Mumbai event took place last year from August 22 through August 24 at NESCO BEC in Mumbai. Director Tetsuro Araki attended the event as the "flagship guest." Voice actor Tsunko ( D4DJ First Mix , D4DJ All Mix ), president of Avex Pictures ' Hideo Katsumata , and DJ Tōko Nakamura also attended the event as guests. Hikari Dobashi attended the event as an exhibitor representing TV Tokyo .

title: Re:ZERO Season 4 Jumps to First Place in Week 7 of Summer 2026 Anime Ranking After Episode 13
content:
Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 4 took the top in the Summer 2026 anime ranking after Episode 13 in Week 7. This is the anime’s first win this season, having placed second in the previous week after the debut of its second part The Recapture Arc .

The first part of the anime dominated our Spring 2026 awards , winning a total of 19 awards. Studio WHITE FOX is animating.

In the latest ranking, the anime took 10.76% of the votes, ranking slightly above BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War . You can check the full ranking , or the top 10 graphic below.

The staff for the 4th season consists of:

• Original Work: Tappei Nagatsuki

• Original Character Design: Shinichiro Otsuka

• Director: Masahiro Shinohara

• Scenario Supervisor: Tappei Nagatsuki

• Series Composition: Masahiro Yokotani

• Character Design / Chief Animation Director: Haruka Sagawa

• Monster Design: Keitaro Chiba

• Prop Design: Goichi Iwahata, Noritaka Suzuki

• Art Setting: Kaoru Aoki (Bihou)

• Art Director: Ryoka Kinoshita (Bihou)

• Color Design: Izumi Sakamoto

• Director of Photography: Miori Miyagi (T2studio)

• 3D Director: Kentaro Ijima (FelixFilm)

• Editor: Hitomi Sudo (REAL-T)

• Music: Kenichiro Suehiro

• Music Production: KADOKAWA

• Sound Director: Jin Aketagawa

• Sound Effects: Yuji Furuya (Swara Production)

• Sound Production: Magic Capsule

• Animation Production: WHITE FOX

The main cast includes:

• Kobayashi Yusuke as Subaru

• Rie Takahashi as Emilia

• Yumi Uchiyama as Puck

• Inori Minase as Rem

• Rie Murakawa as Ram

• Satomi Arai as Beatrice

• Kana Ueda as Anastasia

• Takuya Eguchi as Julius

• Fairouz Ai as Shaula

The first season of the anime aired in 2016, adapting the light novel series by Tappei Nagatsuki and illustrated by Shinichirou Otsuka . The series also announced 10 major projects for its 10th anniversary this year.

title: Duel Masters Lost: Danzai no Shōnen Anime Reveals October 9 Debut
content:
The website for the Duel Masters LOST anime series revealed a visual and October 9 debut on Saturday for the anime's fourth part , Duel Masters LOST ~Danzai no Shōnen~ (The Sentencing Boy). The new anime will have four episodes, and will stream on the Duel Masters official YouTube channel and other services. New episodes will debut every other week on Fridays at 9:00 p.m. JST.

The anime will feature a returning cast. Nina Tamaki will voice the character Lost Kōzaki (name romanization not confirmed). Tamaki previously voiced a "mysterious boy" in the previous anime.

Riki Fukushima is returning to direct the new anime at J.C. Staff and SMDE , with animation production supervision by Yūji Matsukura . Yōichi Katō is returning to oversee the series scripts. Chikara Hashizume is returning to design the characters, and Go Sakabe is returning to compose the music.

Based on the long-running Duel Masters trading card game, Yō Kanebayashi and Shigenobu Matsumoto 's Duel Masters LOST Tsuioku no Suishō ( Duel Masters LOST: Crystal of Remembrance) manga launched in February 2024 and ended in March 2024. Kanebayashi and Matsumoto then launched the Duel Masters LOST ~Gekka no Shinigami~ ( Duel Masters LOST: Reaper of the Moon) manga in August 2024, and ended it in February 2025. Duel Masters LOST ~Bōkyaku no Taiyō~ , the third part of the manga, debuted in September 2025.

Duel Masters LOST ~Danzai no Shōnen~ (The Sentencing Boy), the fourth part , debuted on March 26, and ended on July 2. The final chapter revealed the manga will have a fifth part.

The net anime adaptation of Duel Masters LOST Tsuioku no Suishō debuted in October 2024 and had four episodes. The anime of Duel Masters LOST ~Gekka no Shinigami~ debuted in December 2024 and ended with its fourth and final episode in February 2025.

The anime of Duel Masters LOST ~Bōkyaku no Taiyō~ debuted on February 6 with a four-episode streaming run.

title: Even the Student Council Has its Holes! TV Anime Reveals October 3 Debut in Main Promo Video
content:
The staff for the television anime of Muchimaro 's Even the Student Council Has Its Holes! ( Seitokai ni mo Ana wa Aru! ) four-panel manga revealed the main promotional video and October 3 debut for the anime on Saturday. Sangatsu no Phantasia performs the opening theme song "Kaze no Naka wa Hashirukkya Inai," and the below video previews the song.

The anime will debut on October 3 and will air on Tokyo MX , BS11 , Gunma TV , and Tochigi TV .

Newly revealed cast members include:

• Main Animators: Kay Yu, Konamingu (name romanization not confirmed), Asatoshi Oki, mockingbird, SanzashiAme, and Mushiki (name romanization not confirmed)

• Art Director: Hiromichi Itō

• Color Design: Arisa Komatsu

• Director of Photography: Junpei Takatsu

• Editing: Michi Takigawa

• Sound Director: Satoshi Motoyama

• Music: Tomoki Kikuya

The series stars:

• Shōgo Sakata as Mizunoe Ume

• Haruka Shiraishi as Hisako Kotobuki

• Miyu Tomita as Komaro Michinoku

• Hiyori Kōno as Tan Otori

• Shizuka Ishigami as Arisu Terui

• Yumi Uchiyama as Satomi Hiratsuka

Naoyuki Tatsuwa ( Ōmuro-ke , Gourmet Girl Graffiti , Nisekoi - False Love , Promise of Wizard ) is directing the anime at Passione , Ryo Imamura ( ONIMAI: I'm Now Your Sister! ) is designing the characters and is the chief animation director, and Masahiro Yokotani ( Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! , Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- , Beelzebub , The Devil Is a Part-Timer! ) is overseeing and writing the series scripts.

Seven Seas publishes the manga in English and describes the story:

In a student council filled with weirdos, one new member is about to have a hell of a school year! Mizunoe Ume just wanted to avoid repeating a grade when he joined the student council. After all, it seemed like an easy fix to his current academic problems. But then, he met his fellow council members. Each of them is eccentric in their own way—one's an airhead, another's scary, one's secretly a pervert, but all in all, they're just really weird! Yet somehow, they're also oddly cute and endearing. Which means Mizunoe is stuck with them and all the chaos they bring to the table. Get ready for a slice-of-life manga that's irresistibly charming, quirky, and a little bit naughty!

Muchimaro launched the manga in Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine in 2022. Kodansha shipped the 12th compiled book volume on March 17. Seven Seas will ship the first volume on September 8. K MANGA also publishes the series in English digitally.

The manga received an animated ad in July 2024. The manga won in the print category of the ninth Next Manga Awards (Tsugi ni Kuru Manga Taishō) in 2023.

title: Sekiro: No Defeat Previews Wolf vs Gyobu Battle in New Teaser Trailer
content:
The upcoming SEKIRO: NO DEFEAT theatrical anime revealed a new teaser trailer featuring the battle between Wolf and Gyobu Masataka Oniwa. The anime will begin a three-week limited theatrical run in Japan on September 4, 2026.

The new clip shows the confrontation at the Ashina Castle Gate, with Gyobu entering the battlefield and facing Wolf. You can watch the video below.

The anime is being produced by studio Qzil.la, which is known for working with numerous AI technologies and projects. This caused a part of the audience to believe that the anime adaptation would itself utilize generative AI, which prompted an official statement from the production committee to confirm there will be ‘no generative AI’ used.

The main staff working on the anime can be seen below.

• Director: Kenichi Kutsuna

• Screenwriter: Takuya Satou

• Character Designer: Takahiro Kishida

• Deputy Director: Shunsuke Fukui

• Chief Animation Director: Kaito Moki

• Action Animation Director: Takashi Mukoda

• Art Director: Yuji Kaneko

• Color Designer: Azusa Sasaki

• Cinematographer: Keisuke Nozawa

• Editor: Yoshinori Murakami

• Sound Director: Yasushi Nagura

• Composer: Shuta Hasunuma

• Animation Production: Qzil.la

• Produced by: ARCH

The voice cast was previously announced and includes:

• Daisuke Namikawa as Wolf

• Miyuki Satou as Kuro / The Divine Heir

• Kenjiro Tsuda as Genichiro Ashina

• Jin Urayama as The Sculptor

• Shizuka Ito as Emma

• Akimitsu Takase as Hanbei

• Takaya Hashi as Owl

• Tetsuo Kanao as Isshin Ashina

The main visual for the theatrical release was previously revealed.

The official website describes the story: The time is Sengoku. Japan is fractured into many independent nations entangled in ceaseless war. At the center lies Ashina, a land of sacred earth and ancient mystery. Two decades after Sword Saint Isshin Ashina reclaimed the region in a brutal coup, a new threat emerges from within: The Interior Ministry. Desperate to protect his homeland, Isshin’s grandson Genichiro turns to forbidden powers. The only hope lies in a kidnapped boy — the Divine Heir — and his silent protector: a loyal shinobi known only as Sekiro. This is the story of a lord and his retainer — and their quest to restore balance to a nation on the edge.
